from: June book, night 22 (The Poor Man’s Little Lamb)
p1: King David made a very wrong choice that hurt others. So the Lord sent Nathan, His prophet, to help David see.
Nathan told David a story. A rich man had many sheep. A poor man had one little lamb. It slept in his arms, like his own little girl.
But the rich man took the poor man’s only lamb. David got angry and said, “That man had no pity!”
p2: Nathan said, “You are the man.” The story was about David! David said, “I have sinned against the Lord.” The Lord took his sin away. David prayed, “Make a clean heart in me.”
Because of Jesus, we can feel clean inside again. Tonight, if you are sorry for something, say so. He helps hearts feel new.
old: Heavenly Father sent the prophet Nathan to talk to King David. Nathan told David a sad story about a rich man who took a poor man’s only sheep.
David got SO angry! He said, “That rich man should be punished!” Then Nathan looked at David and said, “YOU are that man! You took what wasn’t yours.”
David’s heart broke. He realized what he had done was very wrong. He cried and said, “I have sinned against Heavenly Father!” He was truly, deeply sorry.
David repented. That means he said sorry, asked for forgiveness, and tried hard not to do it again. Heavenly Father loves us when we repent — He always wants us back!
